public and store users cannot become master, access private businesses, confirm writes or bypass CSRF/type/length checks
store answers use published branch prices, hide unpublished products, reject foreign branches and isolate their history from platform chat
authenticated shoppers see only their own orders in the selected store; anonymous users, other shoppers and other stores are excluded

master contacts exclude store messages; forced password change blocks private full-page and API access immediately

stale proposals, reset proposals and revoked master roles cannot overwrite newer changes or confirm an old action
